body:
## Parent

https://github.com/EvgenyHitexis/EucWatch/issues/43

## What to build

Bring the same four editable defaults, versioned dip semantics and lossless schema-1 migration to the dedicated watch. Demonstrate that native Storage startup, recovery, compatible updates, displayed preset lists and immediate riding-menu application preserve the same saved meanings as the laptop.

Use #43, the agreed domain glossary, ADR 0002 and the confirmed interaction specification. The laptop defaults ticket supplies the exact serialized contract and reusable migration/application fixtures. Use the existing ES5/runtime-compatible application, native Storage and versioned-module conventions. This slice does not reintroduce configuration transfer or require hardware deployment.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Fresh watch configuration exposes four configured editable slots: Jump (assist 0, sensitivity 0, dip 0), Forest (0, 70, 0), Road (25, 30, 10), Drag (70, 20, 5). Every dip is initially omitted from application while its numeric value remains stored. The display uses those saved names; Road needs no wheel read.
- [ ] Use the same new schema meaning and schema-1 migration as the laptop: preserve configured custom IDs/names/sensitivity/assist and alerts; present dip means included, including zero; absent dip means omitted with only its remembered value filled from the fixed slot default; only unconfigured slots receive the full corresponding default. Repeated startup/reload and compatible bundle startup do not reset edits or repeatedly migrate/revise valid content.
- [ ] Adapt all existing watch configuration producers/consumers to retain separate dip value and inclusion, including the interim editor, control request construction and observable views. A complete validated configuration retains the established name and 0–100 whole-percentage contracts.
- [ ] Native Storage active, stage and previous-good copies share the new validation/migration meaning. Preserve bounded size checks, staging/readback validation and recovery warnings. Refused staging or partial/interrupted activation preserves the prior committed configuration and a usable validated recovery route, including first-save/default and migration cases. A valid legacy backup that is the sole good copy is not overwritten before replacement is validated.
- [ ] Corrupt content and unknown schemas remain visible validation/recovery cases, never permission to silently overwrite custom configuration with defaults. Saved/recovered configuration contains neither draft/input state nor pending controls, live wheel settings or confirmation. Independent alert settings and independent recovery remain intact.
- [ ] One tap on each saved default in the riding preset menu requests immediate application through the existing native serialized transport. Construct an immutable request from saved values and explicitly filter dip by inclusion: omitted numeric values emit no dip packet; included zero/nonzero emit the existing corresponding packet. Preserve riding eligibility, revision/session binding, confirmation and bounded failure semantics.

## Tests and evidence

- Run the laptop slice's literal migration and application fixtures through the watch public application actions/raw notifications/observable view/command output. Compare saved meanings and independently specified packet expectations. Do not test private migration helpers or substitute mocked application modules.
- Exercise production main, touch targets, Graphics, actual parser/transport and native Storage code in the existing offline runtime, controlling only clock, flash, BLE and physical inputs. Verify both preset lists and tap each default through native input; record chunks and no omitted-dip command.
- Cover mixed schema-1 custom/empty slots, included zero/nonzero, omitted Road/Drag dip, nondefault alerts, repeated restart and compatible startup. Inject stage refusal, active partial write, missing/corrupt active content, invalid/oversized/unknown-version content and legacy-only backup recovery. Observe Storage effects and recovered application views.
- Confirm custom definitions survive save/restart and old copies remain recoverable during migration; no startup/reload/migration emits a wheel-setting packet or restores confirmation. Preserve native JSON readback/precision checks.
- Keep focused runtime, configuration and control checks green. Retain reusable action/frame results, rendered output, Storage effects, source hashes and explicit simulated-hardware provenance; physical flash atomicity and actual memory fit are not established here.

## Blocked by

- https://github.com/EvgenyHitexis/EucWatch/issues/44 — supplies the versioned configuration contract and reusable migration/application fixtures this watch slice must reproduce.
title: Initialize matching watch presets with native Storage migration
